title: Variables [Bad initialization]
description:
There are two ways to create a variable in Go, but in this lesson, i'll teach the easy-to-understand way. You create a variable with the following syntax:
```go
var balance float64
balance = 47.60
```
In this example, the first line - `var balance float64` - creates a variable named balance, with the datatype float64 to its default value, then the second line, `balance = 47.60`, assigns it to 47.60
